decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 15 December 2006, erection of a single storey rear extension, first floor roof extension and a rear roof extension including three roof lights in the front roof slope to the existing house, as shown on drawing number 739-PL-004 and 739-PL-008, received 15 December 2006; 739-PL-002, 739-PL-003 and 739-PL-005 to 739-PL-007 and 739-PL-009, received 18 January 2007; and 739-SK-02, received 06 February 2007, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed erection of a single storey rear extension, first floor roof extension and a rear roof extension including three roof lights in the front roof slope to the existing house, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1,Class A, Class B and class C, of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
Condition : 3 - The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.
Condition : 4 - The roof lights hereby permitted shall be flush with the existing plane of the roof
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear extension, first floor roof extension and a rear roof extension including three roof lights in the front roof slope to the existing house
